code-review.name: Code Review Formation
code-review.description: Two-wave code review: three parallel specialist reviewers (correctness, security, test coverage) followed by an adversarial synthesis gate and a scoped fix pass. Use for medium-to-large pull requests where a single reviewer might miss cross-cutting issues.

teammates.file_ownership: Read-only — reviews files_changed[] against spec.md acceptance criteria and flags logic errors, edge-case gaps, and design deviations.
Read-only — audits files_changed[] for OWASP Top 10 issues, missing input validation, and insecure defaults. Defensive review only: identifies and explains weaknesses, never drafts exploit code.
Read-only — evaluates test coverage for files_changed[], identifies untested branches and missing edge-case tests.
Read-only — consumes all three wave-1 verdicts, adjudicates any conflicting findings, and emits one adversarial-verify verdict (approve | changes-requested).
Owns applying only the changes the synthesis-gate verdict approved; does not re-open items the gate did not flag.

code-review.task_flow: Wave 1 (parallel): correctness-reviewer + security-reviewer + test-coverage-reviewer each independently review files_changed[] -> Wave 2: synthesis-gate reads all three verdicts, resolves conflicts, emits a single approve/changes-requested verdict -> fixer applies only the approved changes.
